scene.name: barrier
scene.mechanism: a wall segment that is finite in y; the sight line can be taken around it
notes: expect V: 1 -> 0 and stay 0 for forward and back, 1 again after a lateral move
expected best action: left/right, because retreat cannot outrun the wall
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

navigation_added_occluder.generation: one seeded cube, finite fixed candidate list; no walls outside window structures

scene.name: basin
scene.mechanism: a target inside a stepped basin; the near rim occludes it at a grazing angle
notes: measured V(x) is X V X: hidden for x < -5.0, visible -4.95..+1.95, hidden after
the occlusion is a grazing angle, not a wall: from very far away the sight line to a target below the rim hits the flat ground first
note this is the *opposite* ordering from stairs_up: here walking toward the basin is what reveals the target, which is why the direction of the effect has to be measured rather than assumed
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: perlin
scene.mechanism: Perlin/fBm undulation, quantised into walkable steps
notes: measured V(x) is X V X V X V X: six transitions along one traverse
anchors are chosen where the oracle label and the rendered camera agree, so 'hidden' means zero target pixels rather than a sliver
the best action depends on whether the robot is in a trough or on a crest
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

navigation_added_occluder.generation: one seeded cube, finite fixed candidate list; no walls outside window structures

scene.name: perlin_rough
scene.mechanism: rougher Perlin/fBm undulation: tighter features and a larger amplitude
notes: measured V(x) is X V X V X: four transitions
the clean hidden band is only 0.1 m wide here: on fine relief a short target is fully occluded only in the deepest trough, so the oracle label and the rendered camera disagree almost everywhere else
stresses the walkability limit of the vendored policy
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: pit
scene.mechanism: descending into a pit with an unclimbable far wall
notes: expect V: 1 -> 0 and no forward recovery; only retreat restores sight
expected best action: back
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: stairs_down
scene.mechanism: descending staircase; walking down lowers the eye away from the occluder
notes: used to show that descending terrain alone never occludes a target beyond it - see the TASK3 README
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: stairs_up
scene.mechanism: rising crest hides a target that was visible from far away
notes: expect V: 1 -> 0 -> 1 while walking up
expected best action: forward (commit to the climb)
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: trench
scene.mechanism: the robot walks down into a depression; the raised far rim hides the target
notes: expect V: 1 -> 0 -> 1, visible again once the robot climbs the far ramp
expected best action: forward (commit through the depression)
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.

scene.name: waves
scene.mechanism: repeated gentle undulation; visibility flips many times along one path
notes: expect several 1 -> 0 -> 1 transitions
the best action is expected to depend on which trough the robot is in
Calibrated medium; native relief preferred; cubic fallback; versioned terrain changes.
